memory_candidates.content: When pinning a normative shape rule across many agent contracts, add exactly one prose statement in the single normative doc, then extend each existing 'Defensive case' / non-writer-by-design paragraph with one reference-only sentence pointing back at it -- never restate the field table inline. Confirm the sibling-file set with a fresh grep at implementation time (not the plan's hypothesis) and explicitly record any divergence (extra or missing files) rather than silently widening or narrowing scope.

In validate-*.sh element-shape checks, probe `jq -r '.array[idx] | type'` before indexing into named sub-fields. When the type is not 'object', log_fail naming both the index and the observed type and skip the per-field extraction -- this avoids the generic 'missing required field(s)' message masking the real shape defect and avoids raw jq errors on a bare-string element.
